Anya: Quick design review — I pushed a compact invite card variant that surfaces a single-line permissions summary chip, an inline SSO toggle, and a 'view audit' quick-jump. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 Matt: Skimmed it. Love the perms chip for quick scans. Concern: inline SSO toggle might read as a per-invite temporary switch vs an enforcement override. Could confuse admins. :thinking_face: Lex: +1 on potential confusion. Suggest adding a subtle label under the toggle: 'Overrides org setting' when the org-level SSO is different. Also keyboard order is important — recommend: Name -> Email -> Role -> perms chip (popover) -> SSO toggle -> Send. Samir: Accessibility nit: perms chip popover should be accessible without adding extra tab stops. Use `aria-haspopup="dialog"` on the chip and implement roving tabindex in the popover. Also the inline badge color contrast is low on the yellow variant. Jia: Copy tweak: instead of 'Enforce SSO' what about 'Require SSO' or 'Require SSO for this seat'? Shorter label might be better for narrow widths. Add microcopy under the toggle when enabled: 'This will require the recipient to authenticate via SSO.' design-bot: Uploaded variant v3 with hover explanation and aria-labels. PR #4127 linked: https://git.redwood.dev/r/4127 — added tooltip copy and a11y notes. Anya: Two UX edge cases: 1) bulk invites — we collapse the perms chips into a count + "details" link; 2) audit log jump — the 'view audit' should open the audit panel pre-filtered by invite event and the email(s). Also worried about horizontal density on mobile. Matt: For mobile we should collapse the perms chip to "1 role +" with chevron; move the SSO toggle into a details drawer to reduce inline controls. Also propose a confirm toast when toggling SSO with an optional 'undo'. Lex: On the audit navigation: we can shallow-link to /audit?event=invite&email=foo@bar.com — that preserves back button behavior. Add a small spinner if the audit panel is loading filters. Samir: Implementation note (a11y): add `aria-live="polite"` for success states: "Invites sent; audit entry created" so screen readers get feedback. Example snippet: ```
Invites sent; audit entry created
``` Jia: Final copy suggestion: Toggle label = 'Require SSO', tooltip = 'Overrides org SSO setting for this invite', details link = 'View audit'. Keep it short. Anya: Action items: Lex — update Figma for mobile collapse, Samir — write a11y checklist and add to PR, Jia — finalize copy and tooltip microcopy, Matt — validate product constraints and any downstream enforcement changes, I'll add acceptance criteria and QA steps in the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
